title: @ycforge/materializers-core — materializer catalog, artifact value shapes, YMT_* error code catalog
description: Machine-readable contract for the core materializer package (spec 019): the materializer-id → artifact-type catalog (forward contract for dispatch/021), the five Artifact.value shapes (including the two new types ycforge:api-gateway and ycforge:queue fixed here as forward contract), the standalone structural contract replicas, and the catalog of YMT_* materializer diagnostics. Type references here mirror src/types.ts/src/catalog.ts/src/diagnostics.ts of @ycforge/materializers-core (standalone structural types, zero imports from @ycforge/pilot — Constitution I).

outputBuilder.title: OutputBuilder (spec 002, standalone structural replica)
outputBuilder.description: Channel for auto-generated outputs (IDEA §26). value is a Terraform expression string WITHOUT the ${...} wrapper; wrapping during .tf.json serialization is Project C's responsibility.

declare.description: declare(name: string, output: { value: string; description?: string }): void

type.description: Provider resource type (e.g. yandex_function) — known to the materializer only.

configuration.description: Provider-specific schema — opaque to C and to the contracts module (Constitution IV).

value.description: Opaque to C — only the matching materializer interprets it.

materializer.title: Materializer (spec 002, standalone structural replica)
materializer.description: Supports sync + cheap; materialize returns a single TerraformResource OR a readonly array (multi-resource, e.g. bucket + objects — additive contract extension, spec 019 research D-RE-5).

supports.description: supports(artifact, context): boolean — sync, pure, cheap (selection key of dispatch phase 1).

materialize.description: materialize(artifact, context): Promise<TerraformResource | readonly TerraformResource[]> — may declare outputs via context.output.

archivePath.description: Absolute path to the .zip inside outputDir.

image.description: Immutable digest form; mutable tags never appear here.

directory.description: Absolute path to the static build output inside outputDir.

apiGatewayArtifactValue.title: Artifact.value of ycforge:api-gateway (spec 019, forward contract; producer = Project B / composer)

specPath.description: Path to the B-generated OpenAPI spec/template.

queueArtifactValue.title: Artifact.value of ycforge:queue (spec 019, forward contract; producer = explicit configuration)

queueUrl.description: Full Yandex Message Queue URL, e.g. https://message-queue.api.cloud.yandex.net/b1g1/queues/my-queue. Invalid format → YMT_INVALID_QUEUE_URL.

materializer.description: Materializer id that emitted the diagnostic.

errorCodes.title: YMT_* error code catalog
errorCodes.description: Materializer diagnostics of @ycforge/materializers-core (spec 019 Key Entities). Compared via constants in src/diagnostics.ts, never string literals (Constitution V). Codes are additive and non-breaking.

YMT_INVALID_QUEUE_URL.description: Invalid queueUrl format; cannot extract queue_name or region (FR-020/026).

YMT_INVALID_ARTIFACT_VALUE.description: Artifact value missing required fields (e.g., no archivePath).

YMT_EMPTY_DIRECTORY.description: No files in frontend directory (warning; bucket created without objects, FR-024).
